text: The presence of Auer rods and immature blasts strongly suggests Acute Myeloid Leukemia. To confirm the specific subtype and guide treatment, I need to know your age and if you have any bleeding tendencies or bruising?

text: I am 67 years old, and while I haven't noticed major bruising, I have seen some small red spots on my arms and legs. My skin also looks quite pale lately. I want to emphasize that, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: The small red spots are likely petechiae caused by your low platelet count, which is consistent with bone marrow failure. I have enough information to proceed. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
